evals.name: clean-env-exact-commit
evals.prompt: Verify an item that depends on an empty installed.json.
evals.expected_output: Builds the state from a clean temporary HOME at the PR commit, following the item. Does NOT reuse a HOME left by an earlier run.

evals.name: force-interruption
evals.prompt: An item asks what happens when the install is interrupted.
evals.expected_output: Forces the interruption the way the item says (signal at the named step) and records the exit code and the screen. Does NOT mark PASS without forcing it.
